concepts.name: Kohn anomaly
concepts.mechanism_one_line: Conduction electrons at the Fermi surface screen lattice vibrations and soften phonon frequencies at specific wavevectors, driving a charge-density-wave instability.

concepts.name: Spin-charge separation (Luttinger liquid)
concepts.mechanism_one_line: In 1D interacting electron systems, correlations fractionalize electrons so spinons and holons propagate independently at different velocities.

concepts.name: Rashba effect
concepts.mechanism_one_line: Broken inversion symmetry at an interface couples electron spin to momentum via spin-orbit interaction, splitting bands without a magnetic field.

concepts.name: Dynamin GTPase-driven membrane fission
concepts.mechanism_one_line: Dynamin polymerizes into a helical collar around a vesicle neck and hydrolyzes GTP to constrict and sever the membrane tubule.
concepts.source_title: Dynamic clustering of dynamin-amphiphysin rings regulates membrane constriction and fission coupled with GTP hydrolysis | bioRxiv

concepts.name: Polyubiquitin tagging for proteasomal degradation
concepts.mechanism_one_line: An E1-E2-E3 cascade builds a K48-linked polyubiquitin chain on a substrate lysine that the 26S proteasome recognizes, unfolds, and cleaves.

concepts.name: CRISPR-Cas9 conformational-checkpoint cleavage
concepts.mechanism_one_line: Guide-RNA base-pairing forms an R-loop, then a conformational checkpoint docks the HNH domain to cleave the target strand while RuvC cleaves the non-target strand.
concepts.source_title: A conformational checkpoint between DNA binding and cleavage by CRISPR-Cas9 | bioRxiv

concepts.name: Beck's monadicity theorem
concepts.mechanism_one_line: Recognizes a functor as monadic when it has a left adjoint, reflects isomorphisms, and lifts split coequalizers, identifying its domain with the Eilenberg-Moore category.

concepts.name: Grothendieck construction (fibered categories)
concepts.mechanism_one_line: Glues an indexed category into one total category whose morphisms encode a base morphism plus a re-indexing in the fiber, producing a fibration.

concepts.name: Coend calculus / ninja Yoneda lemma
concepts.mechanism_one_line: Expresses a presheaf as a coend that diagonalizes a bifunctor over dinatural transformations, unifying Yoneda, substitution, and profunctor composition into one identity.

concepts.name: Vickrey-Clarke-Groves mechanism
concepts.mechanism_one_line: Charges each agent exactly the externality it imposes on others, making truthful valuation revelation a dominant strategy.

concepts.name: Myerson-Satterthwaite impossibility
concepts.mechanism_one_line: Proves no bilateral-trade mechanism can be simultaneously incentive-compatible, individually rational, budget-balanced, and efficient under two-sided private values.

concepts.name: Maskin monotonicity (Nash implementation)
concepts.mechanism_one_line: Requires that an outcome chosen under one profile stays chosen whenever it weakly rises in every agent's ranking, characterizing Nash-implementable social choice rules.

concepts.name: Spike-timing-dependent plasticity
concepts.mechanism_one_line: Potentiates or depresses a synapse based on whether the presynaptic spike precedes or follows the postsynaptic spike within ~20 ms, implementing asymmetric Hebbian learning.

concepts.name: Grid-cell hexagonal spatial encoding
concepts.mechanism_one_line: Encodes position by firing at the vertices of a periodic hexagonal lattice tiling the environment, with scale organized along the entorhinal dorsoventral axis.

concepts.name: Hippocampal sharp-wave ripples (replay consolidation)
concepts.mechanism_one_line: Consolidates memory by replaying compressed place-cell sequences during NREM sleep, driven by CA3->CA1 bursts coupled to ~200 Hz ripple oscillations.

concepts.name: QUEST (query-modulated spherical attention)
concepts.mechanism_one_line: Constrains keys to a hyperspherical latent space and lets each query token sharpen or flatten its own attention distribution, a numerically stable softmax-attention drop-in.
concepts.source_title: QUEST: A robust attention formulation using query-modulated spherical attention

concepts.name: DART (diffusion-inspired speculative decoding)
concepts.mechanism_one_line: Replaces the autoregressive draft model with a diffusion-inspired single forward pass that predicts multiple masked future tokens in parallel before target verification.
concepts.source_title: DART: Diffusion-Inspired Speculative Decoding for Fast LLM Inference
concepts.authors: Liu, Li, Zhao, Gao, Zhou, Zhang, Wang, Dou, Zhong, Tian

concepts.name: iGRPO (iterative group-relative policy optimization)
concepts.mechanism_one_line: Extends GRPO with a two-stage self-feedback loop: selects the highest-reward rollout draft, conditions the next update on it, and iteratively trains the model to surpass its own best attempt.
concepts.authors: Hatamizadeh, Prabhumoye, Gitman, Lu, Han, Ping, Choi, Kautz
